packageRules.description: Only follow the supported Wazuh 4.14 patch releases, and keep version and apt pins in one PR.
prBodyNotes: Check the OpenSearch version bundled in this wazuh-indexer release (see gradle/libs.versions.toml upstream) and update the prometheus-exporter, repository-* and security-analytics plugin URLs in snap/snapcraft.yaml to match.
